about: v6: what usually goes wrong per scope class. brain_judge.py prints the matching list in the judge brief as hints for `flaws`. A lens never fails a requirement on its own. Edit freely; keep each line checkable from files. Scope classes without their own list use `general`; add a list for your field (finance, legal, data, ...) under any scope class you use.
engineering: Numbers carry units and a source (measured, computed by which command, or assumed).
A simulation states its solver settings, mesh or time step, boundary conditions and a convergence or validation check; a plot alone is not validation.
Geometry files open and match the stated dimensions and units (mm vs m); STL is watertight when it is meant to be printed or meshed.
The result can be reproduced: the command or script that produced it is named and exists.
Graphics, game or WebGL work: it runs from a clean load with no console error, the stated library versions are the ones imported, and frame cost is stated when performance was a requirement.
Tests cover the changed behaviour, not only the happy path that already worked.
website: Every local link, image and script path resolves; no file is referenced that was not delivered.
A viewport meta tag is present and nothing forces sideways scrolling on a 375 px screen.
Text contrast, focus states and alt text exist where the page has interactive or meaningful elements.
No placeholder copy (lorem ipsum, TODO, example.com) is left in a delivery that claims to be final.
Animation and WebGL have a reduced-motion or fallback path when the contract asked for accessibility or performance.
Claims about performance or SEO name the measurement that supports them.
brand: Every colour used in the deliverables is in the stated palette (hex values match exactly).
The type system is consistent: the same families, weights and hierarchy across all pieces.
Logo files exist in the formats the contract names (vector first), with clear space and minimum size stated.
Print pieces state colour mode (CMYK or spot), bleed and finish; a screen mock-up is not a print file.
Bilingual pieces (two languages or two scripts) are both present and typeset correctly (direction, joining) where the contract asks for both.
The concept is stated and the pieces follow it; generic templates dressed in the palette are a flaw.
research: Every factual claim names its source; a claim without one is marked as the author's inference.
Dates, prices and versions are given with the day they were checked.
"Unknown" is stated where the sources do not answer; no gap is filled by plausible guessing.
Sources that disagree are both shown.
cv_official: Dates, titles and employers are consistent across every document in the delivery.
No claim appears that the supplied records do not support.
The document is in the language and format the contract names; page count matches.
system: A change to a tool has a test that fails without it.
Nothing outside the stated scope was switched on, installed or deleted.
The undo path is written down and matches what was changed.
Numbers in the summary (tests passed, sizes, counts) appear in a command result, not only in prose.
general: Every file the summary names exists and is the delivered version.
A number in the summary appears in a command result or an artifact, not only in prose.
Nothing outside the request was changed.
